# Crypto Structure Report

> Daily crypto reporting for builders: exchange mechanics, liquidity shifts, protocol changes and the infrastructure that determines how markets work.

Coverage: Market Liquidity, Trading Infrastructure, Settlement Systems, Protocol Economics.

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://cryptosnews.github.io/): latest reporting and analysis.
- [About](https://cryptosnews.github.io/about/): editorial scope, independence, sourcing and corrections.
- [Archive](https://cryptosnews.github.io/archive/): everything published.
